summary: The SiteProfileHistory class in the HSPnet.DataLayer namespace records historical changes to site profiles, including user actions, fields changed, and timestamps. It supports localization and user identification.
purpose: To track the history of changes made to site profiles and provide formatted user details.

entities.name: SiteProfileHistory
entities.description: Represents a historical record of changes made to a site profile.

fields.name: ActionDate
fields.description: The date when the action was performed.

fields.name: ScreenSection
fields.description: Section of the screen where the change occurred.
